GET.why: Names no record: it answers the licence state of the caller's own tenant, taken from the session, never from the request. ENT-TEST-03 checks that club B gets 404 where club A's key holds.

POST.why: The demo write takes no body and names no record; the tenant comes from the session. ENT-TEST-03 checks 404 for a club without a key and 409 for a read-only one.
